inlineContent.text: The numbers the upstream protocol used for features Headwire does not take (2–7, 15–21, 24, 25, 27, 32) stay
unused so a capture of either protocol never reads as the other. A kind this build does not
and is skipped, so an older peer keeps working against a newer one.
